title: Factory smoke: one small tick end to end
description:
A deliberately small epic for exercising the cloud factory end to end without paying for a full wave. It holds exactly one well-specified, genuinely small tick, so a run has to do the whole loop — plan, create a worktree, dispatch one implementer, implement, push, merge, gate, close — and nothing else.

Use this, not a real multi-tick epic, whenever the thing under test is the FACTORY rather than the work. Run 62c289d1 spent 5.96 and 42 minutes on a seven-tick wave and was killed mid-exploration, which measured the budget and taught nothing about whether a tick can actually complete in the cloud.
